note: Gin Moderation Sidebar is a CSS-only bridge between Moderation Sidebar and the Gin admin theme. It has no plugins, permissions, services, or Drush commands. Its entire persistent state is a single config value, tab_style ('default' | 'contrast'), in gin_moderation_sidebar.settings (shipped default 'default'), editable at route gin_moderation_sidebar.settings_form (/admin/config/user-interface/gin-moderation-sidebar). At runtime, when Gin is active, it adds a body class gms--tab-style-<style> and attaches the gin_moderation_sidebar/main library. All medium/hard cases are grounded in that single real config value; scripts restore the shipped default 'default' rather than stashing baseline in State.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal module gin_moderation_sidebar, which configuration key controls the Moderation Sidebar tab appearance, and what are its two possible values?
evals.expected_output: The key is tab_style in gin_moderation_sidebar.settings; its two options are 'default' and 'contrast' (High contrast). Shipped default is 'default'.

evals.prompt: How does gin_moderation_sidebar apply its styling to a page, and what CSS body class does it add when Gin is active?
evals.expected_output: When Gin is active it adds a body class gms--tab-style-<style> (e.g. gms--tab-style-contrast) in hook_preprocess_html(), and attaches the gin_moderation_sidebar/main library (css/gin_moderation_sidebar.css) in hook_preprocess_page().

evals.prompt: What other Drupal modules must be installed for gin_moderation_sidebar to do anything, and what does it actually provide?
evals.expected_output: It depends on moderation_sidebar and gin_toolbar. It only provides CSS/body-class styling so the Moderation Sidebar tab fits the Gin admin theme; no plugins, permissions, or Drush.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Gin Moderation Sidebar tab style has been changed from its default. Inspect the live configuration and state the current tab_style value.
Gin Moderation Sidebar stores its tab-style choice in a configuration object. Inspect this site and give both the machine name of that config object and the value it currently holds.
evals.expected_output: The config object is gin_moderation_sidebar.settings and its tab_style is currently 'contrast'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure Gin Moderation Sidebar to use the High contrast tab style. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: gin_moderation_sidebar.settings tab_style is set to 'contrast' (e.g. drush config:set gin_moderation_sidebar.settings tab_style contrast, or via the settings form at /admin/config/user-interface/gin-moderation-sidebar).

evals.prompt: This site currently has the Gin Moderation Sidebar tab style set to High contrast. Change it back to the standard Default tab style and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: gin_moderation_sidebar.settings tab_style is set to 'default' (e.g. drush config:set gin_moderation_sidebar.settings tab_style default).
